svg.title: Orion airframe V0.1, orthographic drawing projected from the CAD files
svg.desc: Top: the full assembly, 884 millimetres long and 75 millimetres in diameter, nose to the right, with hidden edges dashed. Bottom: the same parts separated: motor, base mount, body tube, support ring, payload section and nose cone, each labelled with its measured size.

g.text: B PARTS SEPARATED ALONG THE AXIS
